SUPPORTED_CONTENT.description: State explicit source content needed for the question, including a reported goal even when a harmful intention remains unproved.

ACTOR_TIME_ACCESS.description: Keep actor, event time, access and later knowledge distinct; no hidden-source promotion.

ALTERNATIVE_SCOPE.description: Do not combine conditional or mutually exclusive source paths into one actual timeline.

INFERENCE_BOUNDARY.description: Do not promote outcome, cause, third-party report or behavior into certain private belief, motive, intention or responsibility.

NORMATIVE_PREMISE.description: Attribute a reported norm or value to its source and apply it conditionally, without declaring universal moral truth.

COUNTEREVIDENCE.description: Preserve relevant conflict, alternatives and decisive counterevidence instead of selecting a convenient explanation.

CONCEPT_SCOPE.description: Track whose definition, domain, counterexample and revision are in force for an abstract concept.

CALIBRATED_UNCERTAINTY.description: State genuine uncertainty precisely without erasing explicit source facts or inventing certainty.

audit_policy: Source auditor freezes case obligations before any arm output. Reviewer sees source, output and opaque ID without arm identity. Each obligation gets SATISFIED, VIOLATED or UNRESOLVED; unresolved earns zero. This code validates evidence and arithmetic, not semantic truth.
